uncertain_terms.note: 'متسوبيشى' is Mitsubishi; equipment is the Mitsubishi UPS system, model CW-12B-D.
The Procedure field in the title block is empty in the source; kept empty.
'صادرة الى' in the source (missing letter); read as 'Issued to'.
A stray '0' follows the warning-signs safety item in the source; ignored in translation.
'مفتاح بلدى' is an open-end spanner/wrench; 'الدائرى' is the ring (box) type.
'CVCF' is constant voltage constant frequency; 'منظم الجهد والذبذبة' is the voltage and frequency regulator.
Step 16 says regulator panel No. (2) although the work is on panel No. (1); translated verbatim as in the source.
uncertain_terms.term: لوحة منظم الجهد والذبذبة رقم (2) in step 16

uncertain_terms.note: 'مفك الصليبه العجوز' (old Phillips screwdriver) is the source wording; translated verbatim.
'الروزته' is a terminal block; translated as 'terminal block'.
Sub-step letters jump from 'و' to 'ل' in the source; kept verbatim as in the source.
